extra_vocab.en: a meal you eat outside, often in a park
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見在公司活動或週末計畫裡，如 company picnic（公司野餐活動）。天氣不好時常會取消或改期，這種情境很常考。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「去野餐」說 go on a picnic 或 have a picnic，不說 do a picnic。

example.en: Our company holds two picnics every year for all staff.
example.zh: 我們公司每年為全體員工舉辦兩次野餐。

example.en: Everyone picnics in the park after the quarterly meeting.
example.zh: 季度會議後，大家都在公園野餐。

example.en: The team picnicked by the lake after the training day.
example.zh: 訓練日結束後，團隊在湖邊野餐。

example.en: Several employees are picnicking near the parking lot right now.
example.zh: 幾位員工現在正在停車場附近野餐。

example.en: The company picnic will be held on the first Saturday of June.
example.zh: 公司野餐活動將在六月的第一個星期六舉行。

example.en: Our department plans to go on a picnic next month.
example.zh: 我們部門計畫下個月去野餐。

example.en: Please clean up the picnic area before you leave the park.
example.zh: 離開公園前，請把野餐區清理乾淨。

example.en: We reserved three picnic tables for the sales team.
example.zh: 我們為業務團隊預約了三張野餐桌。

examples.en: All employees and their families are invited to the annual picnic.
examples.zh: 所有員工及其家人都受邀參加年度野餐。

examples.en: Please reply by Friday so we can order enough food for the picnic.
examples.zh: 請在週五前回覆，我們才能為野餐訂足夠的餐點。

examples.en: The picnic was canceled because of heavy rain this morning.
examples.zh: 因為今早大雨，野餐被取消了。

examples.en: We usually picnic at the riverside park after the team meeting.
examples.zh: 團隊會議後，我們通常去河濱公園野餐。

similar.diff: outing 是出遊活動，不一定要在戶外吃東西；picnic 一定有在戶外用餐。

example.en: The company outing to the mountains starts at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 公司的山區出遊活動九點開始。

example.en: We will have a barbecue for our clients on Friday.
example.zh: 我們週五要為客戶辦一場烤肉聚會。

example.en: The company picnic is a good chance to meet your coworkers.
example.zh: 公司野餐是認識同事的好機會。

example.en: Staff often picnic on the lawn when the weather is nice.
example.zh: 天氣好的時候，員工常在草坪上野餐。

extra_vocab.en: forms and documents that you must fill in or deal with
extra_vocab.note: 指辦公室裡要填寫、整理、簽署的各種表格與文件，也就是「文書作業」。多益常見在人資、報到、申請和簽約的情境，常和 fill out、complete、sign 一起用。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: paperwork 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a paperwork；要表示量時用 some、a lot of、much。

example.en: Please fill out the paperwork before your first day of work.
example.zh: 請在上班第一天前填好文件。

example.en: I will complete the paperwork and send it to you tomorrow.
example.zh: 我會完成文書作業，明天寄給你。

example.en: Opening a new branch involves a lot of paperwork.
example.zh: 開設新分公司需要處理大量文書作業。

example.en: The manager must sign the paperwork before it goes to accounting.
example.zh: 經理必須先簽署文件，才能送到會計部門。

examples.en: New employees need to finish the paperwork in the HR office.
examples.zh: 新進員工需要在人資辦公室完成文書作業。

examples.en: I have attached the paperwork you need for the visa application.
examples.zh: 我已附上你申請簽證所需的文件。

examples.en: We should reduce paperwork so staff can spend more time with customers.
examples.zh: 我們應該減少文書作業，讓員工有更多時間服務顧客。

examples.en: The supplier will send the paperwork once the order is confirmed.
examples.zh: 訂單確認後，供應商會寄出相關文件。

confusable.diff: paper 是「紙」或「報紙、論文」；paperwork 是要處理的文件與表格工作。
confusable.usage: paper 當「紙」是不可數，當「報紙、論文」是可數（a paper）；paperwork 永遠不可數。

example.en: The printer ran out of paper, so we could not print the forms.
example.zh: 印表機沒紙了，所以我們無法列印表格。

similar.diff: documents 是一份份的文件，可數；paperwork 強調「處理文件的工作」，不可數。

example.en: Please bring all the necessary documents to the interview.
example.zh: 請把所有必要的文件帶來面試。

similar.diff: 範圍更廣，包含所有行政事務，不只是文件與表格。

example.en: She does administrative work for the sales department every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上為業務部處理行政工作。

example.en: Please sign the form and return it to the front desk.
example.zh: 請在表格上簽名，並交回櫃檯。

example.en: The legal team is reviewing the document before the meeting.
example.zh: 法務團隊正在會前審閱這份文件。

example.en: Please put the signed contract in the customer file.
example.zh: 請把簽好的合約放進客戶檔案。

extra_vocab.en: how much work a person or company can do in a certain time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見在公司管理與員工會議的情境，談提高工作效率或工廠產量，常和 increase、improve、boost 一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: productivity 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a productivity；形容詞是 productive。

example.en: The new software helped us increase productivity by ten percent.
example.zh: 新軟體幫助我們把生產力提高了百分之十。

example.en: Better training can improve productivity in every department.
example.zh: 更好的訓練可以改善每個部門的工作效率。

example.en: Flexible hours may boost productivity and keep staff happy.
example.zh: 彈性工時可能提升生產力，也讓員工更開心。

example.en: A drop in productivity worried the factory manager last quarter.
example.zh: 上一季生產力下降，讓工廠經理很擔心。

examples.en: Our main goal this year is to raise productivity in the factory.
examples.zh: 我們今年的主要目標是提高工廠的生產力。

examples.en: Please share any ideas that could help our team's productivity.
examples.zh: 請分享任何能幫助我們團隊生產力的想法。

examples.en: The report shows that productivity rose after the new system started.
examples.zh: 報告顯示，新系統開始使用後生產力上升了。

examples.en: Regular breaks can keep productivity high during long work days.
examples.zh: 規律的休息能讓員工在漫長的工作日維持高效率。

confusable.diff: production 是「生產」這件事或產量；productivity 是生產的效率。

example.en: Production at the plant stopped for two days last week.
example.zh: 工廠的生產上週停了兩天。

similar.diff: efficiency 強調不浪費時間與資源；productivity 強調完成的工作量。

example.en: The new schedule improves efficiency without adding any extra cost.
example.zh: 新的時程在不增加成本的情況下提高了效率。

example.en: Our monthly output has doubled since we bought new machines.
example.zh: 自從買了新機器，我們的月產量增加了一倍。

example.en: Her performance at work earned her a promotion.
example.zh: 她在工作上的表現讓她獲得升職。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞：把東西做出來，後面的字都從它長出來
produce 生產 → product 生產出來的東西
produce + -tion，動詞變名詞，像 reduce → reduction

extra_vocab.en: a person who gives a talk or shows information to a group
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見在會議、研討會和簡報的情境，指上台報告的人。也可指電視或廣播節目的主持人。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「報告的人」是 presenter，不是 presentator；presentation 是「簡報」這件事，不是人。

example.en: Three presenters will speak at the afternoon session of the conference.
example.zh: 三位報告人將在研討會的下午場次發言。

example.en: Our guest presenter will talk about online marketing today.
example.zh: 我們的特邀報告人今天會談網路行銷。

example.en: The main presenter arrived early to test the projector.
example.zh: 主要報告人提早到場測試投影機。

example.en: We plan to invite a presenter from the head office.
example.zh: 我們打算邀請一位總公司的報告人。

examples.en: Each presenter has only fifteen minutes to explain the new plan.
examples.zh: 每位報告人只有十五分鐘說明新計畫。

examples.en: The presenter answered questions from the audience after her speech.
examples.zh: 報告人在演講後回答聽眾的問題。

examples.en: Please send the presenter your slides by noon on Thursday.
examples.zh: 請在週四中午前把你的投影片寄給報告人。

examples.en: The presenter of the morning news show is very popular.
examples.zh: 這個晨間新聞節目的主持人很受歡迎。

confusable.diff: presentation 是「簡報、報告」這件事；presenter 是做簡報的人。

example.en: Her presentation on sales results lasted about twenty minutes.
example.zh: 她關於銷售成績的簡報大約進行了二十分鐘。

similar.diff: speaker 指任何演講的人，也有「喇叭」的意思；presenter 多指用簡報或資料做報告的人。

example.en: The keynote speaker will open the conference at nine.
example.zh: 主題演講者將在九點開啟這場研討會。

example.en: The host welcomed everyone to the sales conference.
example.zh: 主持人歡迎大家來到銷售研討會。

example.en: The audience asked many questions about the new product.
example.zh: 聽眾問了許多關於新產品的問題。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞：把東西拿到大家面前
present + -ation，動詞變名詞，像 organize → organization

senses.en: a person who gives a talk to a group

example.en: The presenter showed sales charts to the whole team.
example.zh: 報告人向全體團隊展示了銷售圖表。

senses.en: a person who hosts a TV or radio show
senses.distinguish: 在會議、研討會看到是「報告人」；談電視、廣播節目時是「主持人」。

example.en: The radio presenter interviewed a local business owner this morning.
example.zh: 廣播主持人今早訪問了一位當地企業老闆。

extra_vocab.en: a machine that makes copies of paper documents
extra_vocab.note: 辦公室設備的常見字，多益常考在「影印機卡紙、沒紙、故障、要維修」的情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「機器壞了」說 The photocopier is out of order 或 is broken；「影印」這個動作用動詞 photocopy 或 make copies。

example.en: The office has two photocopiers on the second floor.
example.zh: 辦公室二樓有兩台影印機。

example.en: May I use the photocopier for a few minutes?
example.zh: 我可以用一下影印機嗎？

example.en: A technician came to fix the photocopier this morning.
example.zh: 技術人員今早來修理影印機。

example.en: The photocopier is jammed again, so please use the other one.
example.zh: 影印機又卡紙了，請用另一台。

collocations.phrase: the photocopier is out of order

example.en: The photocopier on this floor is out of order.
example.zh: 這一層樓的影印機故障了。

examples.en: Please refill the paper in the photocopier before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請幫影印機補紙。

examples.en: We called the service center because the photocopier was making a loud noise.
examples.zh: 因為影印機發出很大的聲音，我們打電話給服務中心。

examples.en: Our company decided to replace the old photocopier with a faster model.
examples.zh: 我們公司決定用速度更快的機型換掉舊影印機。

examples.en: The photocopier will be unavailable on Monday while the technician checks it.
examples.zh: 技術人員週一檢查期間，影印機將無法使用。

similar.diff: 意思相同，說法更短，口語常用。

example.en: Please check whether the copier has enough paper and ink.
example.zh: 請檢查影印機的紙和墨粉是否足夠。

similar.diff: 美式口語常見說法，意思和 photocopier 相同。

example.en: Someone left the original on the copy machine again.
example.zh: 又有人把原稿忘在影印機上了。

example.en: The printer in the sales office is very slow.
example.zh: 業務辦公室的印表機速度很慢。

example.en: Use the scanner to send the contract by email.
example.zh: 請用掃描機把合約用電子郵件寄出。

derived.link: 最基礎的字：複製一份出來
photo（光、影像）+ copy，用光線複製＝影印

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to paint walls, or a person who paints pictures
extra_vocab.note: 多益在大樓整修、辦公室粉刷的情境常出現「油漆工」，在美術館或展覽的情境則是「畫家」，要看上下文判斷。

example.en: The painters finished the lobby walls before noon today.
example.zh: 油漆工今天中午前就完成了大廳的牆面。

example.en: We need to hire a painter before the office opens again.
example.zh: 辦公室重新開放前，我們需要僱用一位油漆工。

example.en: A professional painter will repaint the meeting room next week.
example.zh: 一位專業油漆工下週會重新粉刷會議室。

example.en: The museum is showing works by a famous painter.
example.zh: 博物館正在展出一位知名畫家的作品。

examples.en: The painter is coming tomorrow to paint the reception area.
examples.zh: 油漆工明天會來粉刷接待區。

examples.en: Please let the painters into the building at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 請在八點讓油漆工進入大樓。

examples.en: This painter's paintings will be on display at the gallery until May.
examples.zh: 這位畫家的作品將在畫廊展出到五月。

examples.en: The painter gave us a price for the whole building.
examples.zh: 油漆工給了我們整棟大樓的報價。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音都相近：printer 是印表機或印刷業者，painter 是油漆工或畫家。

example.en: The printer needs new ink before we print the brochures.
example.zh: 我們印手冊之前，印表機需要換新的墨水。

similar.diff: artist 是所有藝術家的總稱；painter 只指用顏料作畫的人。

example.en: The company asked an artist to design the new logo.
example.zh: 公司請一位藝術家設計新的標誌。

example.en: Please clean the brush after you finish the wall.
example.zh: 牆刷完後，請把刷子清乾淨。

example.en: The painter climbed a ladder to reach the ceiling.
example.zh: 油漆工爬上梯子去刷天花板。

derived.link: 最基礎的字：塗上顏色，加 -er 變成做這件事的人

senses.en: a worker who paints walls and buildings

example.en: The painter needs two days to finish the second floor.
example.zh: 油漆工需要兩天才能完成二樓。

senses.en: an artist who makes pictures with paint
senses.distinguish: 談整修、牆壁、建築時是油漆工；談美術館、展覽、作品時是畫家。

example.en: The gallery will hold an exhibition of a local painter.
example.zh: 畫廊將舉辦一位當地畫家的展覽。

extra_vocab.en: a person who often uses a shop, restaurant, or library
extra_vocab.note: 比 customer 更正式，多用在餐廳、飯店、圖書館、劇院等場所的告示與公告。另可指贊助藝術或活動的人。

example.en: The restaurant welcomes patrons of all ages every weekend.
example.zh: 這間餐廳每個週末歡迎各年齡層的顧客。

example.en: He has been a regular patron of this cafe for years.
example.zh: 他多年來一直是這間咖啡店的常客。

example.en: Each library patron may borrow up to five books.
example.zh: 每位圖書館讀者最多可借五本書。

example.en: We thank every valued patron for coming to our sale.
example.zh: 感謝每一位尊貴的顧客來參加我們的特賣。

examples.en: Patrons are asked to turn off their phones during the show.
examples.zh: 請顧客在演出期間關閉手機。

examples.en: Many patrons wait outside the restaurant at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 午餐時間有許多顧客在餐廳外等候。

examples.en: Library patrons can renew their books online or at the desk.
examples.zh: 圖書館讀者可以在線上或櫃檯續借書籍。

examples.en: The museum thanked a patron for supporting the summer exhibition.
examples.zh: 博物館感謝一位贊助者支持夏季展覽。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近：patent 是「專利」，patron 是「顧客、贊助者」。

example.en: The firm applied for a patent on its new machine.
example.zh: 這家公司為它的新機器申請了專利。

confusable.diff: 發音相近：patient 是「病人」，patron 是「顧客」。

example.en: Each patient must show an ID card at the clinic.
example.zh: 每位病人在診所都必須出示身分證。

similar.diff: customer 最通用，任何買東西的人都是；patron 更正式，常指常客。

example.en: Every customer will receive a coupon with the first order.
example.zh: 每位顧客第一次訂購都會收到優惠券。

similar.diff: client 是接受專業服務的客戶，如律師或顧問的客戶。

example.en: Our client wants to change the meeting time to Friday.
example.zh: 我們的客戶想把會議時間改到週五。

derived.link: patron + -age，表示顧客的行為，店家常說 Thank you for your patronage

senses.en: a person who often uses a shop, restaurant, or library

example.en: The hotel gave a small gift to each patron.
example.zh: 飯店送給每位顧客一份小禮物。

senses.en: a person who gives money to support an artist or event
senses.distinguish: 在商店、餐廳是顧客；談藝術、慈善、活動經費時是贊助者。

example.en: A wealthy patron paid for the new concert hall.
example.zh: 一位富有的贊助者出資興建新的音樂廳。

extra_vocab.en: a paper from a doctor that lets you get a certain medicine
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見在醫院、藥局和保險的情境，如 fill a prescription（到藥局領藥）。也常用來形容需要醫師開立的藥，如 prescription drugs。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「某種藥的處方」用 a prescription for + 藥名，不用 of。

example.en: The pharmacy can fill most prescriptions within thirty minutes.
example.zh: 藥局可以在三十分鐘內配好大部分的處方藥。

example.en: You can fill your prescription at the pharmacy downstairs.
example.zh: 你可以在樓下的藥局領處方藥。

example.en: The doctor will write a prescription for this medicine.
example.zh: 醫師會為這種藥開一張處方。

example.en: Please call us when you need to refill your prescription.
example.zh: 需要再次領藥時，請打電話給我們。

example.en: Prescription drugs must be kept in a safe place.
example.zh: 處方藥必須放在安全的地方。

examples.en: Please show the prescription to the pharmacist at the front desk.
examples.zh: 請把處方箋拿給前台的藥師看。

examples.en: Our health plan covers part of the cost of each prescription.
examples.zh: 我們的健保方案涵蓋每張處方的部分費用。

examples.en: Your prescription will be ready for pick up after two o'clock.
examples.zh: 你的處方藥兩點後就可以來領。

examples.en: Employees need a doctor's prescription to buy this kind of medicine.
examples.zh: 員工需要醫師的處方才能購買這類藥品。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近：description 是「描述、說明」，prescription 是「處方」。

example.en: The job description lists all the duties of the new manager.
example.zh: 職務說明列出新經理的所有職責。

confusable.diff: subscription 是「訂閱」（雜誌、服務），prescription 是醫師開的處方。

example.en: Your magazine subscription will end at the end of this month.
example.zh: 你的雜誌訂閱將在本月底到期。

example.en: The pharmacy next to the clinic opens at eight.
example.zh: 診所旁的藥局八點開門。

example.en: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
example.zh: 藥師說明了這種藥該怎麼吃。

example.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
example.zh: 這種藥請在飯後每天吃兩次。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞：醫師開藥。加 -tion 變成名詞 prescription，像 describe → description

senses.en: a note from a doctor that says what medicine you need

example.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for my cough.
example.zh: 醫師開了咳嗽的處方箋給我。

senses.en: the medicine that a doctor tells you to take
senses.distinguish: 說 write / show a prescription 是處方單；說 pick up a prescription 是領藥。

example.en: I will pick up my prescription on the way to work.
example.zh: 我會在上班途中去領處方藥。
